limits: Mac melonDS DS1.3.1, software renderer/builtin BIOS; isolated HG-derived project progress, not a fresh HG/SS story or universal save-compatibility claim.

Wild acceptance uses native walking, generated roaming models and original contact battles with no RAM fixture. Earlier missed HeartGold chase branches are exploratory and excluded; accepted HG lineage uses actual current slot0 contact via LEFT/UP/A.

Each trainer fixture changes 35 unused script-stack bytes and one four-byte pointer. The native VM creates Mikey47, checks native battle victory and conditionally sets the native trainer flag before resuming the follower script. Pokemon, teams, HP, coordinates, rewards and save flags are not injected. This is not a real NPC story playthrough.

Settings/cold source branches retain the declared ancestry of milestones22/23, including earlier native legendary release/location/ball-supply fixtures. No such Pokemon data is edited in this milestone.

Original overlay helper, faint and EXP dispatch execute in instruction tests with controlled loader/script services. Actual native trainer replacement and ordinary Off controls establish the bounded gameplay path.

Ordinary action/status/field timers are not advanced by the automatic faint handoff. Special-format guards have instruction scope; wider actual trainers/story, doubles/partners, roamer/contest, volatile/status/ability, capacity, leveling/evolution and long-play acceptance remain pending.

Pre-fix24a experiments passed a smaller suite but faulted during native replacement because menu overlay10 had not yielded to battle overlay7. They and all diagnostic edits are excluded. Accepted24b runs have the original overlay handoff and no data/prefetch abort, and final images/patches reproduce them exactly.

Private getters preserve input Pokemon bytes. Any cold lead-byte change is exactly the original native follower mood reset; a private native setter reproduces every cold byte. Live verification state is never modified by inspection.
Other unfinished enhancements remain in the full goal. These candidates are experimental, not final releases.
